newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end sharply off, Jan under support.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end sharply off, Jan under support.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed at contact lows for the second consecutive session as the Janary contract slipped under the psychologically-key 100.00 mark.
The most-active contract settled at 99.15, down 1.95, having ranged from 101.60 to 99.10, a lifetime low. The deferred months settled 2.20 to 1.85 weaker, hitting contract lows across the board.
Speculative selling and trade scale-down buying accounted for today's volume, estimated at a brisk 4,500 lots.
While January fell below resistance, market sources said the contract has more room on the downside.
"Technically, we are in an oversold zone but the charts are still pointing lower," an analyst said. She said the most-active contract could fall another 3.00 to 4.00 cents before bottoming out.
The fundamental outlook also points to a weaker market as supplies for the 1996/97 season are seen adequate, and Brazil is in the market for a buyer.
